review_notes: I read the whole file and Defs.lean, which defines `StdSimplex`, `single` and `map`. I searched Mathlib for other barycenter, centroid and uniform-weight notions. The only competing barycenter is `stdSimplex.barycenter` in Mathlib/Analysis/Convex/StdSimplex.lean. That one is already deprecated with `@[deprecated StdSimplex.barycenter +typeChanged]`, so this file is its replacement, not a rival. `Finset.centroid` and `Finset.centerMass` live in affine and linear spaces. They return points of a space and are not elements of `Convexity.StdSimplex`. `PMF.uniformOfFinset` is the uniform probability distribution, but it is a different structure with different API (ENNReal-valued). Nothing in the file reimplements an existing concept. I am not certain whether a generic bridge from `PMF` to `StdSimplex` exists, but I found none, so I did not report one.
